data.value:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED select DISTINCT DocumentDate,tab.CreateDate,tab.CompanyID,DocumentType,DocumentTypeID ,CostCenterName ,tab.CustomerID ,case when HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode is null then tab.CustomerName else tab.CustomerName + ' (' + HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode + ')' end as CustomerName ,DocumentNo ,debit ,credit ,InstrumentNo ,Comments ,CodeCombinationID ,CodeDescription ,InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO ,(Select OperatingUnitName from SET_OperatingUnit where OperatingUnitId = tab.CompanyID) as UnitName from ( select @FromDate AS DocumentDate,@FromDate AS CreateDate,CompanyID, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,0 AS DocumentTypeID,'' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.CustomerName,null as DocumentNo,
Abs(Sum(Debit)) debit,
Sum(credit) as credit,'' as InstrumentNo,'' as Comments, CodeCombinationID CodeCombinationID,CodeDescription ,'' as InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
from ( SELECT 'Opening' as DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Comments, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO FROM ( Select distinct OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, Sum(OpeningTAB.Debit) As Debit, Sum(OpeningTAB.Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description As Comments, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID ,OpeningTAB.CodeDescription,OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber From ( --------------- Sale Inovice Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalID is null and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0 AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate {9}--{9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.employeecode is not null {0} {5} {6} {11} ) As OpeningTAB Group By OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID , OpeningTAB.CodeDescription, OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber
UNION ALL ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.employeecode is not null {0} {5} {6} {11} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
UNION ALL ---------- Sales Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Narration, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From Sal_InvoiceHeader
Inner Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail On Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode
inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode Where Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(Sal_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) < @FromDate {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.employeecode is not null and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' {0} {5} {6}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
union All ---------- Purchase Invoice Customer Detail ---------- OPENING Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate,AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber as DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Narration, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode as CustomerAccountCode , Case When AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From AR_InvoiceHeader
Inner Join AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail On AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Status=1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode
inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode
Where AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And IsNull(AR_InvoiceHeader.IsReversed, 0) = 0 And AR_InvoiceHeader.ReversalID is null AND convert(date,AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate) < @FromDate {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.employeecode is not null and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%opening%' {0} {5} {6}
) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
Union All
---------- Sales Receipt Customer Detail ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select DISTINCT GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and PBD.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and PBD.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo, '' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader On AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail On AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Status=1 ANd GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1
--Left Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID -- And AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status=1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null AND convert(date,GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.employeecode is not null and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like '%OPENING%' {0} {5} {6} {11} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, CreateDate,CompanyID,FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
union all ---------- Sales Receipt Customer Detail - Opening ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate, CreateDate,CompanyID,FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select DISTINCT AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,SET_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Narration, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode, Case When AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo, '' as InvoiceNumber From AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader Inner Join AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail On AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID
left join SET_CostCenter on SET_CostCenter.CostCenterID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CostCentreID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerAccountCode Where AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null AND convert(date,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate ) < @FromDate and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.employeecode is not null and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%OPENING%' {0} {5} {6} {11} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, FinTab.Narration, FinTab.CustomerAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
union all
---------- Payment Supplier Detail ---------- OPENING Select FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, Fintab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode As CodeCombinationID, FinTab.CodeDescription ,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct Ap_paymentHeader.DocumentDate, Ap_paymentHeader.CreateDate,Ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, '' as CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, Ap_paymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Narration, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode, Case When AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID , STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AP_PaymentBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and PBD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and PBD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo ,case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT Distinct ',' + AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID --ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumber ,'' as GRN_NO,'' as PO_NO From Ap_paymentHeader Inner Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail On AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status=1 -- Left Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail On AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID --And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --And AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.status=1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = Ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = Ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = Ap_paymentHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 left join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode Where Ap_paymentHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID and Ap_paymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments is null and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like 'Grower Loan Payment' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType not like 'Employee Bank Payment' {9}--and ((GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID between @AccountCode and @AccountCodeTo) OR (@AccountCode is null) OR (@AccountCodeTo is null)) AND convert(date,Ap_paymentHeader.DocumentDate) < @FromDate And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) and AR_Set_Customer.employeecode is not null {1} {6} and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%OPENING%' ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
union all
